name: Curvy Mole 83
author: MazontheMoon
description: Gradient rounded dark red notification that glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, top becomes 2px, background changes from #840f00 to radial-gradient(hsl(6, 100%, 18%), hsl(6, 100%, 16%)), box-shadow becomes inset 0 1px 0 hsl(6, 100%, 25%), 0 2px 0 hsl(6, 100%, 22%),
    0 3px 0 hsl(6, 100%, 18%), 0 4px 0 hsl(6, 100%, 16%),
    0 5px 0 hsl(6, 100%, 12%), 0 6px 0 hsl(6, 100%, 10%).
combined: ★ New level ★
